premise: A cloud covers the moon on the way home and Badger and Raccoon can't see a thing, but Mouse feels the way with his whiskers — this way, that way — and leads them along, giggling, nose to tail.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: no rescue from danger, just the smallest one leading the big ones home through a cosy, giggly dark.
lesson: The smallest friend can lead the way.
learning: Mice feel their way in the dark with their whiskers.

en-US.title: Mouse Leads the Way
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7 30s} {sfx:crickets} [softly] The moon was up, and {badger:enter} Badger was out with {raccoon:enter} Raccoon and little {mouse:enter} Mouse. {badger:live} He dug up one last snack. Time to go home! {canvas:clouds 0.8 22s} But a big cloud slid over the moon. {badger:face surprised} Oh! {all:fade-out 0.4 3s} I can't see a thing! said Badger. {raccoon:live hold} [giggles] Me neither! said Raccoon, paws over his eyes. {badger:wobble} Is that your nose? {raccoon:shake} No, that's my tail! Then Mouse's whiskers twitched. {mouse:face happy} [whispers] Follow me, he said. {mouse:sparkle} My whiskers can feel the way. {mouse:live hold} Up he stood on his tiptoes. Twitch, twitch… {mouse:live resume} This way! {badger:go to mouse} Badger followed Mouse. {raccoon:live resume} Raccoon peeked. BOO! Then {raccoon:go to badger} he followed Badger. {sfx:rustle} Past the rocks. Round the ferns. Twitch, twitch, twitch. Then the cloud drifted away, and there was the moon again… {badger:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} and there they were, all in a row, nose to tail! [laughs] {mouse:hop} Mouse, you did it! {mouse:hearts} [happily] Badger twitched his own whiskers. Next time, he said, I'll try that.

es-ES.title: Ratón enseña el camino
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7 30s} {sfx:crickets} [softly] Había salido la luna, y {badger:enter} Tejón estaba fuera con {raccoon:enter} Mapache y el pequeño {mouse:enter} Ratón. {badger:live} Cavó en busca de un último bocado. ¡Hora de volver a casa! {canvas:clouds 0.8 22s} Pero una nube grande tapó la luna. {badger:face surprised} ¡Oh! {all:fade-out 0.4 3s} ¡No veo nada! dijo Tejón. {raccoon:live hold} [giggles] ¡Yo tampoco! dijo Mapache, tapándose los ojos. {badger:wobble} ¿Esto es tu nariz? {raccoon:shake} ¡No, es mi cola! Entonces a Ratón le temblaron los bigotes. {mouse:face happy} [whispers] Seguidme, dijo. {mouse:sparkle} Mis bigotes notan el camino. {mouse:live hold} Se puso de puntillas. Tiqui, tiqui… {mouse:live resume} ¡Por aquí! {badger:go to mouse} Tejón siguió a Ratón. {raccoon:live resume} Mapache se destapó: ¡BU! Y {raccoon:go to badger} siguió a Tejón. {sfx:rustle} Junto a las rocas. Entre los helechos. Tiqui, tiqui, tiqui. Entonces la nube se apartó, y volvió a salir la luna… {badger:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} ¡y allí estaban los tres, en fila, nariz con cola! [laughs] {mouse:hop} ¡Lo has conseguido, Ratón! {mouse:hearts} [happily] Tejón movió sus propios bigotes. La próxima vez, dijo, lo pruebo yo.

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording

rustle.prompt: small animals padding softly through grass and ferns at night, gentle rustle, realistic
